taste.name: Accent as a reading marker
taste.trigger: When a content-heavy personal site needed an identity colour
taste.decision: Chose to confine #B0390F to section numbers, underlines and active states over a brand-coloured background or buttons
taste.reason: Because a colour that appears rarely tells the reader where they are each time it does appear
evidence: primary button is ink #1F1D1A, not accent

taste.name: Paper without depth
taste.trigger: When grouping status panels, timelines and project rows
taste.decision: Chose two flat surface tones and 1px rules over elevated cards with shadows
taste.reason: Because the notebook metaphor collapses the moment anything floats above the page

taste.name: Metadata speaks monospace
taste.trigger: When labelling dates, numbers, versions and tags
taste.decision: Chose IBM Plex Mono at 12px over small sans-serif captions
taste.reason: Because a log-like voice separates annotation from narrative and fits a systems-administration profile

taste.name: The name owns the first screen
taste.decision: Chose a 136px serif name with a 0.6em asymmetric indent over a moderate headline scale with a photo
taste.reason: Because the visitor's first question is who this is, and a typographic answer avoids stock imagery
